mergedPRs.title: fix(cache): replace Lua EVAL with scanStream for Redis Cluster compatibility (KAT-11170)
mergedPRs.author: junetengext-a11y
mergedPRs.body:
## Problem

Release Redis is running in Cluster mode, but `CacheService.delByPattern` uses a Lua `EVAL` script with `numkeys=0`. Redis Cluster does not support this — all pattern-based cache invalidation fails silently with:

```
ERR Lua scripts without any input keys are not supported
```
